biotools.summary: movetrack is an R package that uses a hidden Markov model to reconstruct animal flight paths from radio-telemetry data, such as that collected by the Motus Wildlife Tracking System. It combines coarse geometric position estimates with movement dynamics to distinguish behavioral states like migratory flight, local movement, and stopovers.
